protocol.continuation: all-advance-v1; q=log(native latency / same-program root default latency); maximize -q; S2 observe-only retains S1 branch score

training.selection: minimum validation candidate-set log regret; if no distinguishable validation pairs use frozen final epoch; regression never breaks ties
training.objective: stage root-relative log-cost interval regression and matched-prefix pair ranking; policy baseline retains whole-trajectory preference loss

protocol.limitations: All action targets re-enumerated per actual IR. One all-advance continuation, finite conditional value not Q*. Validation regret restricted to sampled candidate set. Seen Queens/Puzzle never select epochs. Default seat is charged as one of three terminals; search protection is not memory. Do not lower thresholds or replace programs based on measured effects.

limitations: one new block-cipher test family; Queens/Puzzle diagnostics only
no distinguishable validation ranking group; every model uses preregistered final epoch
only PC1 S0 has strong matched action pairs; no harmful-action training labels
q is fixed all-advance continuation, not optimal future-policy value
same update count/data, different training compute for whole-trajectory policy vs shared-prefix q
same binary timing differences are noise; uncontrolled frequency/load
unused historical policy/value/resource modules excluded from active-module parameter counts; raw checkpoints retain them
B160 approximates A total stored parameters, not q objective-active capacity; A S2 observation block receives no q loss. Do not infer memory superiority from capacity variants.
Per-model Torch peak memory was not independently measured; native child RSS is retained in raw timer records.

stages.invariant: complete source module; func/affine/scf/memref/polygeist; no tensor stage

backend.lineage: function/module anchors retained; arbitrary lowering internals unknown

acceptance.fresh_des_replay: A/B structure, candidate ranks, q/value/resource floats exact after removing session-local snapshot/branch identities

implementation_issue: Initial interleaving stopped before any timed call because forked default lacked program-source.json. Fork now propagates source metadata; frozen adapter reads original root records for already-produced forks. Reused all trained weights and 192 compiler runs; only measurement resumed.
parameter_count_scope: Active-module counts exclude q-unused policy/value/resource modules and A S2 observation-only block; include full tables in called embeddings, so not a count of individually nonzero gradients. Physical model still stores all checkpoint tensors.
